identityRule: Resolve the exact candidate SHA and tree from each immutable qualification-summary.json. After release, git rev-parse hns-production-v1 and git rev-parse main must resolve the same qualified tree.

authoritativeEvidence.selection: latest PASS run whose gitSha equals the final candidate SHA
PASS run from the fresh remote clone whose gitSha equals the final candidate SHA

authoritativeEvidence.scope: real-input construction evidence; final cleanroom visual evidence is reported separately

forbiddenCompositions: results from different runIds combined as one qualification
synthetic soak labelled as real wall-clock soak
process or Electron restart labelled as Windows reboot
a candidate SHA inferred from a branch name without reading the run summary
